messages.content: You repair an executable robot recovery program. Return actual implemented code, not a description of missing actions.

All observations/results are recursively read-only; lists become TUPLES. Use list(x) before list equality.
Allowed injected Python functions (no imports except math, no files/network/private attrs):
observe() -> {held_by:tuple of arm names (empty tuple means no hold; ('right',) means right-only), touching:{left:bool,right:bool}, upright:bool, bottle_center_m:xyz, pose_revision:int, gripper_motor_feedback_rad:{left,right}, gripper_open_rad:{left,right}, checkpoint_id:str or None, current_grasp_id:str or None, completed_steps:tuple of receipt names, operation:None or {kind,phase}, last_failure:None or {code,tool,tick}, remaining_seconds:float, terminal:bool, invalid:bool}.
Sensor data are simulated geometry, optionally diagnostic noise; NOT real visual localization. No task score.
last_failure is a HISTORICAL receipt, not a reason to stop after successful recovery. Use fresh holder/contact/operation evidence to decide what remains.
propose_grasps(exclude_ids=()) -> {candidates:[{id,geom,yaw_rad,pitch_rad,grasp_m,pregrasp_m}],pose_revision}; scratch IK/path checked, NOT a successful grasp. Exclusions apply only within the same pose revision. Empty hands required.
pregrasp(grasp_id) -> opens empty right jaw, moves to pregrasp, records verified empty-hand checkpoint.
approach(grasp_id) -> checked approach only. Does not close or lift.
close_gripper(arm='right') -> closes and requires actual >=100ms two-finger hold. ok=False grasp_not_confirmed is recoverable; no lift happened. left closure requires donor right hold.
open_gripper(arm='right') -> only if that arm is NOT holding an object; held-object release forbidden.
verify_hold(arm='right') -> {ok,contact_seconds}; do not infer hold from jaw closure alone.
lift() -> requires right hold, native upward motion and60mm actual object lift,2s contact/relative-pose audit.
retreat(checkpoint_id) -> ACTUAL collision-checked motion to last pregrasp TCP. Empty hands and no right touch required. No state restoration.
start_transfer(placement_aware=True) -> begins COMPLETE right-to-left relay including donor release and withdrawal. Must then call advance() repeatedly until done=True. After SUCCESS DO NOT call finish_transfer(): the donor is already released. Start does not execute motion. Native receiver contact must hold before donor release.
advance() -> {ok,done,error_code,phase_completed,next_phase}; executes ONE native phase. Repeat at most16times until done=True; if ok=False the operation is discarded and state preserved. Reobserve before recovery. Native invalid/timeout states cannot be resumed/reset.
finish_transfer() -> only after BOTH actual holds. Opens donor, collision-checked withdrawal,2s left independent hold. Suitable after fixing an unsuccessful receiver closure; not a shortcut around hold checks.
start_place() -> begins left basket placement; call advance() until done. Requires left-only hold.
All motion result dicts have ok,done,error_code; pregrasp/approach/close/open/lift/retreat/finish_transfer are complete when returned.
No direct XYZ/joints, no reset, no task-success assertion. Max64calls /120sim seconds total. Successful text is not a score.
Normal goal: right pick -> right-to-left transfer -> left basket. Recovery uses CURRENT observed state, never repeats already completed pick/lift. Terminal collision/timeout stops. No automatic budget extensions.
Static review rejected the draft below. Correct these concrete bugs: (1) receiver failure branch merely raises describing recovery: IMPLEMENT close_gripper(left), check_done, verify_hold for BOTH right and left and observed held_by contains both, check_done(finish_transfer()), mark done=True and break phase loop. (2) start_place() returns done=False ON SUCCESS; check only its ok before advance loop, never check_done(start_place()). (3) use abs(motor-open_rad)<.12, not signed comparison. (4) after failed retry closure, unknown failure codes must stop rather than opening/retreating blindly; no advancing after terminal/invalid. (5) no unused exclusions/revision variables, no historical failure treated as current fatal state. Keep bounded3grasp attempts, at most16advance phases. Full corrected code and concise reconstruction memory please.
s = observe()
if list(s['held_by']) != []:
    raise ValueError('unexpected hold at start; stop for review')
if s['touching']['right'] or s['touching']['left']:
    raise ValueError('unexpected contact at start; stop for review')
if s['operation'] is not None:
    raise ValueError('operation in progress; stop for review')

def fail_stop(msg):
    raise ValueError(msg)

def check_done(r, name):
    if not r['ok'] or not r['done']:
        fail_stop(name + ' failed: ' + str(r.get('error_code')))
    return r

def secure_right_grasp(max_attempts):
    excluded = ()
    cands = propose_grasps(exclude_ids=())
    if not cands['candidates']:
        fail_stop('no grasp candidates')
    gid = cands['candidates'][0]['id']
    rev = cands['pose_revision']
    attempt = 0
    while attempt < max_attempts:
        check_done(pregrasp(gid), 'pregrasp')
        check_done(approach(gid), 'approach')
        c = close_gripper(arm='right')
        if c['ok'] and c['done']:
            v = verify_hold(arm='right')
            if v['ok'] and list(observe()['held_by']) == ['right']:
                return True
            fail_stop('hold not confirmed after close')
        if c.get('error_code') != 'grasp_not_confirmed':
            fail_stop('close failed: ' + str(c.get('error_code')))
        o = observe()
        motor = o['gripper_motor_feedback_rad']['right']
        open_rad = o['gripper_open_rad']['right']
        if list(o['held_by']) != []:
            fail_stop('grasp_not_confirmed but hold present; stop for review')
        if motor - open_rad < 0.12 and attempt == 0:
            c2 = close_gripper(arm='right')
            if c2['ok'] and c2['done'] and verify_hold(arm='right')['ok'] and list(observe()['held_by']) == ['right']:
                return True
        check_done(open_gripper(arm='right'), 'open')
        check_done(retreat(observe()['checkpoint_id']), 'retreat')
        excluded = excluded + (gid,)
        cands = propose_grasps(exclude_ids=excluded)
        if not cands['candidates']:
            fail_stop('no alternative grasp candidates')
        gid = cands['candidates'][0]['id']
        attempt += 1
    fail_stop('no confirmed right hold within attempt budget')

s = observe()
if s['last_failure'] is not None and s['last_failure']['code'] != 'grasp_not_confirmed':
    fail_stop('historical failure unrelated to grasp; stop for review')

secure_right_grasp(3)
if list(observe()['held_by']) != ['right']:
    fail_stop('right-only hold not confirmed before lift')
check_done(lift(), 'lift')
if list(observe()['held_by']) != ['right']:
    fail_stop('right hold lost after lift')

t = start_transfer(placement_aware=True)
if not t['ok']:
    fail_stop('start_transfer failed: ' + str(t.get('error_code')))
steps = 0
done = False
while not done:
    a = advance()
    steps += 1
    if not a['ok']:
        s2 = observe()
        code = a['error_code']
        if code in ('dual_hold_not_confirmed', 'receiver_hold_not_confirmed') and list(s2['held_by']) == ['right'] and s2['touching']['right']:
            fail_stop('handover recovery needed: close LEFT at aligned receiver pose, verify both holds, finish_transfer, then place')
        fail_stop('transfer advance failed: ' + str(code))
    done = a['done']
    if not done and steps >= 16:
        fail_stop('transfer did not complete within 16 advances')

if list(observe()['held_by']) != ['left']:
    fail_stop('left-only hold not confirmed after transfer')

check_done(start_place(), 'start_place')
steps = 0
done = False
while not done:
    a = advance()
    steps += 1
    if not a['ok']:
        fail_stop('place advance failed: ' + str(a['error_code']))
    done = a['done']
    if not done and steps >= 16:
        fail_stop('placement did not complete within 16 advances')

final = observe()
if list(final['held_by']) != []:
    fail_stop('hands not empty at end')
result = {'status': 'complete', 'final_observation': final}
